findings.title: duplicate: `TWorkingHours` has the same shape as U-002's `TimeWindow`
findings.detail: `TWorkingHours = { start; end }` matches `TimeWindow` at src/features/appointments/utils/slots/index.ts:28, committed before this unit. Two names for one type. Keep one source: move `TimeWindow` into types and import it in slots, or alias `export type TWorkingHours = TimeWindow`.

findings.title: Date/time format checks on the form schemas have no tests
findings.detail: `dateField` / `timeField` (index.ts:30-34) are the timezone-free contract but no test passes them a malformed value. Add rejection cases for bookingSchema / rescheduleSchema ('9:15', '09:15:00', '09:15Z', '2026-13-01', '15/09/2026') and assert the readable messages.

findings.title: duplicate: each payload type is declared twice (hand-written `T*` and inferred `*Values`)
findings.detail: Nothing uses the aliases; `satisfies z.ZodType<T>` only checks one direction so fields can drift. Pick one source.

findings.title: Test title doesn't match what it asserts
findings.detail: The cancel/reassign test also asserts rescheduleSchema rejects its defaults; split it out.

findings.title: No whitespace-only test for the payload schema's patient fields
findings.detail: Add a case with patient.name '  ' and reasonForVisit ' '.

findings.title: Mass assignment: shared create schema lets callers set staff-only fields
findings.detail: createAppointmentPayloadSchema accepts bookingChannel 'staff' (line 130) and override (line 131); the PRD gives both only to the receptionist role. Any public create route that parses with this schema accepts a patient's own override. No route uses it yet, so nothing is exploitable at this commit. Fix: split patient/staff schemas, or have the create route check the receptionist role before accepting either field.

findings.title: Input validation: no length limit on unauthenticated free-text fields
findings.detail: requiredText only trims and checks min(1); add .max(n) limits for name, phone, reasonForVisit, ids and token.
